pages.title: Merchant Backpack
pages.text: A wearable, openable storage pack sold only among the Merchant's rare stock. It costs both a Golden Ogre Tooth and diamonds.

pages.title: Ogreblood Totem
pages.text: Another rare Merchant relic, demanding an even greater tooth payment. Its normal tooltip records the exact behavior.
Captains carry the currency. The Merchant decides what it is worth.
